args: import pathlib,tarfile,hashlib,json,sys; p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/ontosary-smoke-inputs.tar'); assert hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==sys.argv[1]; b=pathlib.Path('/opt/s2-smoke'); assert not b.exists(); b.mkdir(); t=tarfile.open(p); assert all(m.isfile() and not m.name.startswith('/') and '..' not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).parts for m in t.getmembers()); t.extractall(b,filter='data'); manifest=json.loads((b/'manifest.json').read_text()); assert all(hashlib.file_digest((b/n).open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==h for n,h in manifest.items()); p.unlink(); print(sys.version)
